name: The Ritz-Carlton, St. Louis
positioning: Ritz-Carlton hotel in the Arts and Garden District of Clayton, Missouri, with an Italian restaurant, a spa and a Club Lounge on the 18th floor
best_for: Travelers who want a Club Lounge stay with rooms on the same floors
Guests who enjoy spa treatments, a late-night cigar lounge and Italian dining
Families who like a hotel scavenger hunt for children

facts.text: The hotel is in the Arts and Garden District of Clayton, Missouri.
The Club Lounge offers four presentations a day: breakfast, lunch, hors d'oeuvres and dessert.
The Missouri Black Walnut Massage uses sticks carved from locally sourced black walnuts.
The fitness center is open 24 hours.
The fitness center has Peloton bikes.
Young guests get a special registration experience and a hotel-wide scavenger hunt.
The hotel offers a Casa Don Alfonso Pizza Making Class as a hotel experience.
St. Louis Lambert International Airport is 8.0 miles from the hotel.
Guests must be 18 or older to access the spa facilities.

highlights.text: ACHI is an omakase experience with a 10-course tasting menu served at a 6-seat counter on select nights.
Casa Don Alfonso, the hotel's Italian restaurant, serves Southern Italian flavors.
The spa's signature massages use ingredients such as Missouri red granite.
The Club Lounge is on the 18th floor and overlooks the city's Garden and Cultural Arts District and the lights of Clayton.
Club guest rooms and suites are on the 17th and 18th floors, steps from the Club Lounge.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
WhataHotel notes an urban setting with limited outdoor space.
